events.title: New Show
events.description:
Atlanta’s 3rd Stream Big Band ignites the stage with an electrifying fusion of Pop, R&B, Funk, and Rock, reimagined through the bold power of a full big band sound. Driven by high-octane horns, a thundering rhythm section, and sizzling arrangements, this genre-bending ensemble smashes musical boundaries with every performance. From iconic anthems to modern chart-toppers, the band delivers a nonstop sonic thrill ride that keeps audiences moving, grooving, and craving more.

Fronted by some of the southeast’s finest vocalists, combining powerhouse performances and magnetic stage presence, the 3rd Stream Big Band doesn’t just play music — they own it. Whether belting soul classics, shredding funk riffs, or rocking out with searing solos, this group transforms every concert into a dynamic celebration of sound and style. Perfect for festivals, corporate events, and concert halls alike, the 3rd Stream Big Band delivers a high-energy, unforgettable experience that brings audiences to their feet.

Grab your friends, bring a blanket or chair, and let’s rock the block all summer long! Fridays have never sounded better!
